summaryForCaller: The wiring claim in docs/phase-3f1-human-architecture-decision/04-structural-implementation.json holds up under this auditor's own independent, from-first-principles verification: a real user's compile run genuinely reaches parseDocumentStructureWithTriage + the bounded structural-ambiguity classifier via runContractAnalysis, and the fail-closed synthetic-fallback path genuinely fires through the real pipeline (not merely in unit tests) in this credential-less environment. Across 27 fresh adversarial cases (never copied from any implementer or prior-auditor test file) spanning every required shape in both directions, plus dedicated rank-stack-corruption composition checks and a real end-to-end Postgres-backed pipeline test with TWO independent ambiguous citations in one document, this auditor could not falsify the required safety property: zero false CONFIDENT_HEADING acceptances, zero false CONFIDENT_PROSE_REFERENCE rejections, and zero material rank-stack corruption in either direction. Every genuinely hard case correctly and safely resolves to AMBIGUOUS/UNCERTAIN (never a confident wrong answer), and ordinary confident documents cost exactly zero classifier calls, confirmed via call-counting stage callers at both the isolated-function and full-orchestrator level.
